title: Pager big-endian file u32 I/O

scope.rationale: read32bits and write32bits centralize exact four-byte big-endian integer transport through sqlite3_file and preserve the read output on failure.

external_source_responsibilities: sqlite3_file provides a live xRead or xWrite method
Callers supply valid nonnegative file offsets
dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete helpers and generated blocks are assigned; production journal append and playback consume them.

inputs: Borrowed output pointer or u32 input value
outputs: Exact VFS ResultCode and decoded output only after successful read
contracts.state_and_results: read32Bits performs one four-byte read, decodes big-endian only on success, and leaves output unchanged on every failure. write32Bits encodes exactly four big-endian bytes and performs one write.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Exactly one sqlite3_io_methods xRead or xWrite call; caller owns synchronization.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Missing methods map to IOERR. VFS primary/extended result codes are preserved. Failed read does not publish partial bytes.

representation_differences: Zig uses ResultCode instead of a raw integer result and typed u32 pointers.
The helpers dispatch through the public sqlite3_io_methods layout used by both VFS files and the memory-journal owner.

oracle.protocol: Write 0x1234abcd at offset zero into a memory journal, inspect exact bytes 12 34 ab cd, read the value back, then short-read from offset one and require an existing 0xfeedbeef output to remain unchanged.
oracle.normalization: Compare exact bytes, u32 value, and ResultCode.

assurance.oom: No allocation inside helpers; memory-journal growth belongs to xWrite.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: One VFS operation per call; atomicity and locking belong to the VFS/caller.
assurance.malformed_input: Typed four-byte local buffers prevent partial decode; missing methods return IOERR.
assurance.continuation: Failed reads preserve caller output and both helpers leave file ownership intact.
assurance.performance: Constant time and fixed stack storage.

integration.production_owner: src/core/pager.zig rollback journal append and playback
integration.native_call_path: appendJournalRecord uses write32Bits for page number and checksum; playbackJournal uses read32Bits for both fields.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Inline four-byte buffers in append/playback are retired.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C I/O fault trace, wider journal call-site conversion, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Convert remaining super-journal and journal-header integer I/O as those owners are ported.
Add pinned-C short-read/write and extended-code trace.
